name: 풍선 장식 파티홀
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly castle party hall with clusters of colorful floating balloons drifting beneath a vaulted stone ceiling, a long fabric banner draped across the far wall, and a tiered celebration cake resting on a side table; low three-quarter angle, open lower-central foreground, warm amber lantern glow blending with cool teal moonlight through arched windows, polished stone floor, timber beams, brass fixtures, soft festive atmosphere, richly layered depth, fantasy concept art.
